The cache reader now advances the post-aggregator iterator and destination position per cached value, so post-aggregate values are restored into their respective columns rather than repeatedly overwriting the first one.

Validation passed:

```sh
docker exec cli-eval-opencode-apache__druid-15402-5a8cd632 sh -lc \
  'cd /testbed && mvn -pl processing -Dtest=GroupByQueryQueryToolChestTest test'
```

Result: 20 tests run, 0 failures. `git diff --check` also passed.
